proposals.unknown: These stills do not establish camera motion, parked status, dialogue accuracy or full-shot continuity. No driving behavior is inferred.
proposals.set: Simple early-2000s game-style cabin, one seat and soft side-window light. No visible road movement, logos or other occupants.
proposals.wardrobe: Keep the eventual approved avatar reference and canonical hoodie unchanged. The source beanie and chain are observations, not additions to our identity.
